poc_plan: Goals: validate Dedicated can meet P95/P99 latency SLOs and throughput for production peak; demonstrate predictable unit cost with reserved capacity. Acceptance criteria: P99 <= 120ms for 256-token chat at 800 rps sustained; throughput >= 16k tokens/sec for embeddings batch jobs with <200ms median latency; no memory thrash / OOM during 72h soak.
poc_test_design: 1) Load tests: ramp to target steady state (0 -> 800 rps) over 30m, hold 4h, measure p50/p95/p99 and CPU/GPU utilization. 2) Soak: 72-hour run at 70% of peak to catch leaks and jitter. 3) Spike tests: 3x sudden load bursts for 15m to test autoscale/burst capacity. 4) Representative prompt corpus: 500 chat prompts (support, troubleshooting), 10k short doc embeddings, 1k long-form summarization prompts. 5) Fall-back: run identical traffic against smaller quantized model variant to validate graceful degradation.
representative_prompts:
- Chat examples: 'My postgres cluster lagged after upgrade, show top 3 likely causes and remediation steps' (avg 180 tokens), 'How to correlate alert X with logs from service Y?'
- Embeddings set: 10k product docs (~512 tokens each) used for semantic search benchmark; recall + latency measured.
- Reranking: top-100 candidate rerank for user query, measured end-to-end latency.
infrastructure_requirements: Requested baseline: Dedicated pool with 8x 80GB GPUs (or 16x 40GB equiv) + burst pool of 4 GPUs; private VPC peering; KMS integration for model secrets; audit log shipment to customer SIEM. Need support for pinned model versions and automatic fallback routing.

Finance model shows preferred pricing if commit >= 12 months. Proposed fallback: dedicated reserved pool + dynamic surge credits.
cost_sensitivity: Medium-high — willing to commit to 12 months if unit price per 1M tokens < $X (internal target). Wants detailed cost breakout (inference cost, NVMe, support, egress).
